newsitem.title: USA: Giant Eagle says does tender offer for Riser shrs.
newsitem.headline: Giant Eagle says does tender offer for Riser shrs.

text.p: Giant Eagle Inc said Wednesday its cash tender offer for class A common stock of Riser Foods Inc expired Tuesday, with about seven million shares tendered.
The company said the tender offer represents 96 percent of all Riser's outstanding shares of class A common stock.
Giant Eagle said it plans to accept and promptly pay for all shares it has received.
The company said the amount tendered includes about 237,000 shares tendered according to guaranteed delivery procedures.

Each share of class A common stock not tendered will be converted into the right to receive $42.00 in cash, without interest, according to a merger between Talon Acquisition Co, a wholly-owned subsidiary of Giant Eagle, and Riser Foods.
The company said the merger is expected to be completed within 25 days, subject to extensions to meet regulatory approvals.
Giant Eagle operates 56 company-owned stores and supplies 86 independently owned Giant Eagle stores. Riser Foods operates 35 company-owned stores under the Rini-Rego Stop-n-Shop banner.
